Of these: 13,099 were convicted of homicide", "reason": "The BBC page states the 13,099 figure is homicide convictions on the non-detained docket as of July 2024, covering decades and including people incarcerated by other agencies, not 2024 murders."}

parsed.note_claim: ICE's 13,099 figure is the cumulative total of noncitizens with homicide convictions (over many years, some in prison) on the non-detained docket as of July 2024, not 13,000 murders in 2024.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: as of July 2024, there were 425,431 non-citizens with criminal convictions on ICE’s "non-detained docket" ... Of these: 13,099 were convicted of homicide
parsed.reason: The BBC page states the 13,099 figure is homicide convictions on the non-detained docket as of July 2024, covering decades and including people incarcerated by other agencies, not 2024 murders.
